baseline.name: Scan forward independently for every warmer day
baseline.approach: For each index, inspect later temperatures until finding a strictly warmer one.
baseline.space: O(1) auxiliary, excluding the n-result array

archived.name: Monotonic unresolved-index stack
archived.time: O(n) amortized, because every index is pushed once and popped at most once
archived.space: O(n) auxiliary stack and O(n) returned result

why: Each unresolved day is stored once and removed when its first warmer day arrives.
quantitative_comparison: On nonincreasing input the baseline compares n(n-1)/2 day pairs. The archive pushes n indices and pops at most n indices, with amortized linear loop work. Stack actions and temperature comparisons differ, so this does not establish a numeric elapsed-time factor.
tradeoffs: Uses O(n) auxiliary stack storage. Equal temperatures must not resolve each other, and both allocations are unchecked.
evidence_basis: Static source inspection and stated algorithm work/storage model. Comparator is an analytical alternative, not an implemented or timed benchmark. Historical platform acceptance is separate from current local validation.
